query: INSERT INTO usage_daily AS u (day, org_id, project_id, user_id, service_account_id, api_key_id, catalogue_model_id, model_id, provider, requests, errors, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, reasoning_tokens, cost) SELECT * FROM unnest($1::date[], $2::uuid[], $3::uuid[], $4::uuid[], $5::uuid[], $6::uuid[], $7::uuid[], $8::text[], $9::text[], $10::bigint[], $11::bigint[], $12::bigint[], $13::bigint[], $14::bigint[], $15::bigint[], $16::bigint[], $17::numeric[]) ON CONFLICT (project_id, day, api_key_id, user_id, service_account_id, provider, model_id) DO UPDATE SET requests = u.requests + excluded.requests, errors = u.errors + excluded.errors, input_tokens = u.input_tokens + excluded.input_tokens, output_tokens = u.output_tokens + excluded.output_tokens, cache_read_tokens = u.cache_read_tokens + excluded.cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens = u.cache_write_tokens + excluded.cache_write_tokens, reasoning_tokens = u.reasoning_tokens + excluded.reasoning_tokens, cost = u.cost + excluded.cost, catalogue_model_id = coalesce(excluded.catalogue_model_id, u.catalogue_model_id)
